result.rationale: Verified: addGuests.handler.ts computes `uniqueGuests` (filtering out existing attendees/blacklisted emails) but then calls `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` with the raw input. In email-manager.ts, attendees whose email is in newGuests get `AttendeeScheduledEmail` (full booking confirmation), so passing duplicates causes existing attendees to receive re-confirmation emails with ICS instead of the AddGuests notification. This is a real correctness defect introduced by the diff.

judged_text: The handler passes the raw input guests (which may contain emails of already-existing attendees, duplicates, or blacklisted emails) to sendAddGuestsEmails instead of uniqueGuests, so the email branch's newGuests.includes(attendee.email) test classifies existing attendees as 'new guests'. When a caller passes an email that is already an attendee, that attendee receives a full AttendeeScheduledEmail (booking-confirmation email with ICS) instead of the AddGuests notification, re-sending confirmations to people who already booked and desynchronizing notification content from what actually changed.
